ko.theme_title: ⚠️ 경고: BTS 안무, 현실 왜곡 시작!
ko.theme_desc: BTS의 '다이너마이트' 안무가 현실에 구현되어, 중력이 춤추는 대로 바뀌며 인류는 리듬에 맞춰 멸망.

scenarios.10y: BTS 춤에 맞춰 그림을 그려야 하는데, 손이 말을 안 들어서 붓을 입으로 물었어.
scenarios.20y: 중력 춤 덕분에 캔버스가 우주로 흩날리고, '은하수 추상화'로 전시회 1등 했대!
scenarios.30y: 춤추는 중력 덕에 모두가 예술가가 되어, 'BTS 댄스 아카데미' 설립자로 추앙받는 중이래!

en.theme_desc: The 'Dynamite' choreography manifests in reality, altering gravity to the rhythm of the dance, leading humanity to its doom in a synchronized dance.

scenarios.10y: Had to paint while following BTS's dance, but my hands just won't cooperate, so I'm painting with my mouth.
scenarios.20y: Thanks to the gravity dance, my canvases are scattered across the universe, and I won first place in the 'Milky Way Abstract' exhibition!
scenarios.30y: Everyone became an artist thanks to the dancing gravity, and now I'm revered as the founder of the 'BTS Dance Academy'!
